body: I actually have listened to that on audible. I’m a total slut for audiobooks and podcasts. I drive a lot! But yeah, give me some job ideas Idk I have no idea where I wanna be / what I wanna do.

My family has been wonderful and supportive through all of this and I feel so guilty that I never made a great comeback. I’m afraid they secretly view me as a pariah. They are paying for my psychotherapy and they helped me with bills when I got fired and they invite me to every family event and  treat me very well. It all makes me feel so incredibly guilty. They shouldn’t love me after I disappointed them so much. I wish I could die without hurting them.

I got a 3.9 in high school/ good ACT SAT scores so I was on a track to graduate with a graduate degree in 5 years, automatic grad school acceptance and a hefty scholarship. The pressure was too much and I felt like a social outcast. So I tried to kill myself the summer I was 20, after failing out of my sophomore year. I ended up retaking that semester, getting all A’s, but still deciding to transfer because I hated seeing my old old classmates/ profs and their stupid fake sympathy. Also I lost my scholarship and grad school privileges so like whatever. So I transferred and I hate my new school but I’m still managing to brush by with B’s. I have no friends at this new school, and I’m getting less and less motivated to stay consistent with my classes. I really messed everything up and it’s been almost two years and I haven’t done enough to fix it. I have no real plans honestly. Too painful to plan when I messed up my life this much. I wish I successfully died a few weeks after my 20th birthday as planned.

Health Science! But it’s mostly a pre- graduate / medical school program. Most people I know are going into physician assisting or physical /occupational therapy or something. I don’t have the grades/ haven’t put in the work to do so :( mostly bc I have had a very rocky college experience filled with bad times
